input.value: Kitchen fire - grease flare-up on stove
Fire in stove during sauteing; extinguished with fire extinguisher; charred cabinets above stove; smoke damage to ceiling and walls
Localized to kitchen; rest of house unaffected

input.rationale: Kitchen fire caused structural damage to cabinets and fire/smoke damage to walls and ceiling, which is clearly a property damage claim covered under the homeowners policy.
Localized fire damage to kitchen cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling/walls requires repair but is contained to one room; no injuries; well within coverage limits of $250,000 with $500 deductible.

input.claim_summary: Kitchen fire damage from grease flare-up on stove; charred cabinets and smoke damage to ceiling/walls; localized to kitchen; no injuries; medium severity.
